name: Assistance for Protected Cultivation
nodalDept: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
briefDescription: The scheme “Assistance for Protected Cultivation” by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote protected horticulture practices by providing financial assistance to farmers for mulching, plug nursery, polyhouse, shed net house, and nursery development.
descriptionMd: The scheme “Assistance for Protected Cultivation” by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote modern, climate-resilient horticulture practices by providing financial support for protected cultivation infrastructure like mulching, nursery development, and plug nurseries. The scheme encourages self-employment and sustainable income generation for farmers through the use of polyhouses, shed net houses, and starter kits to improve crop productivity and resource efficiency.
benefitsMd: > **Plastic Cover (Mulching):** - **General Area:** ₹32,000/- per hectare. - **Hilly Area:** ₹36,800/- per hectare. - 50% of the expenditure incurred, limited to 1 hectare per beneficiary. - **Self-Employment Oriented Horticulture Nursery Development Programme:** - **Nursery Structure:** ₹3,50,000/- per unit - ₹3,00,000/- per unit for 500 sq.m. area - **Starter Kit:** ₹50,000/- per unit - Assistance up to 65% of the cost or ₹2,27,500/-, whichever is less. > **Shed Net House & Polyhouse:** - **Coverage:** 500 sq.m to 4,000 sq.m - Assistance as per square meter cost based on empanelled company prices - Structures supported: Cylindrical, bamboo, and wooden. > **Plug Nursery:** - **Public sector:** ₹30,00,000/- per hectare for 1 hectare - **Private sector:** Assistance of 50% or ₹15,00,000/- per hectare (whichever is less) for 1 hectare.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a farmer.
applicationMd: > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on &#39;Login&#39; from the top right-hand side, then click on &quot;Beneficiary Registration&quot; and select any one from the &#39;Farmer&#39; or &#39;Institutional&#39; or &#39;Except For the Farmer&#39; as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose &#39;what type of account holder you are?&#39;, enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click &#39;Save and Next&#39;. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and Email address, click &#39;Send OTP&#39;, enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click &#39;Submit&#39;. <br> > **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on &#39;Login&#39; from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the &quot;Apply New&quot; button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the &quot;Update Application&quot; button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application. <br> > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx)
